response.rationale: All options are unmatched to the provided leaf. Therefore, the ranking is based on the confidence score. Option C has the highest confidence score (0.7), followed by B (0.6), D (0.6), and A (0.2). When confidence scores are equal (B and D), the original prior option rank is used as a tie-breaker, but in this case, both B and D have a prior rank of 1, so their relative order is arbitrary but consistent with the confidence score. The prompt states to prefer higher support_score / confidence when leaf ranks are equal, and since all options are unmatched, this rule applies to the options themselves.
